content.json:
# Voltrieve operations
Who uses the assistant, how fast it answers, which tools and knowledge bases it uses, and what it costs. For what is happening this second, open **Live Metrics** in Application Insights or the live dashboard, an app of its own. Costs are **estimates** from token counts and list prices, not the bill. Users are counted by pseudonym, and our own telemetry stores no prompts or answers. Foundry's tracing is disconnected, see the privacy check.

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "chat.turn"
| extend backend = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.backend"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.user"]),
    outcome = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.outcome"]),
    error_code = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.error_code"]),
    first_text = todouble(customDimensions["voltrieve.first_text_ms"]) / 1000.0,
    total = todouble(customDimensions["voltrieve.duration_ms"]) / 1000.0,
    cost = todouble(customDimensions["voltrieve.cost_sek"]),
    tools = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.tools"]),
    kbs = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.knowledge_bases"]),
    model_calls = toint(customDimensions["voltrieve.model_calls"]),
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
    cold_start = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.cold_start"]) == "True",
    request_kind = tostring(customDimensions["voltrieve.kind"])
| where "{Backend}" == "all" or backend == "{Backend}"
| extend message_first_text = iff(request_kind == "message", first_text, real(null))
| summarize users = dcount(user), turns = countif(request_kind == "message"),
    first_text = percentile(message_first_text, 50), cost = sum(cost)
| project pack = pack_array(
    pack("metric", "Users", "value", todouble(users), "note", "distinct pseudonyms"),
    pack("metric", "Messages", "value", todouble(turns), "note", "questions to the assistant"),
    pack("metric", "First text, median (s)", "value", round(first_text, 2), "note", "seconds"),
    pack("metric", "Estimated cost (SEK)", "value", round(cost, 2), "note", "estimate, not the bill"))
| mv-expand pack
| project metric = tostring(pack.metric), value = todouble(pack.value), note = tostring(pack.note)
content.title: At a glance

content.json:
## Cost
Estimated from token counts and list prices in `api/app/insights.py`. The prompt agent does not report Search reasoning tokens, so its estimate is low. Fixed costs (Search, registry, containers) are in **Cost Management** for the resource group.

content.json:
## Privacy check
**What our code writes.** Every attribute name stored on a turn, with the longest value seen. Only ids, names, counts and timings belong here: no prompt, answer or user name. A long value is worth a look.

content.query:
dependencies
| where name == "chat.turn"
| mv-expand kv = customDimensions
| extend key = tostring(bag_keys(kv)[0])
| extend value = tostring(kv[key])
| summarize longest_value = max(strlen(value)), example = take_any(iif(strlen(value) <= 40, value, "")) by key
| order by key asc
content.title: Attributes stored on chat.turn

content.json: **What Foundry's own tracing writes** (cloud role `responsesapi`), for turns on the prompt agent and the hosted agent. **This check should be empty**: Application Insights was disconnected from the Foundry project on 2026-11-24 at 14:25 UTC. Rows from before that hold prompts and answers, and stay until retention removes them (30 days). A newer row means that chat text can reach telemetry again. Counts only: the text is not shown. See *Closed: Foundry's tracing is disconnected* in the decisions.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true withsource=stored_in dependencies, genAIContent
| where cloud_RoleName == "responsesapi"
| extend content = tostring(pack_all())
| summarize row_count = count(), with_client_line = countif(content contains "From the client"),
    with_photo = countif(content contains "data:image" or content contains "base64"),
    longest_row = max(strlen(content)), newest_at = max(timestamp) by stored_in
| order by stored_in asc
content.title: Rows written by Foundry's tracing
content.noDataMessage: No rows from Foundry's tracing in this time range.

content.json:
## What people ask
Only topics shared by at least five people are shown. Counts are rounded to five. A missing number means under five people or held back, not zero. Real and made up are never added: the **Source** below picks one of them, and every item here follows it.

content.query:
let ins = VoltrieveInsights_CL | where Source == "{Source}";
let last_end = toscalar(ins | summarize max(WindowEnd));
let last_run = toscalar(ins | where WindowEnd == last_end | summarize max(Run));
let newest_rows = ins | where WindowEnd == last_end and Run == last_run;
newest_rows
| summarize people = max(iff(Cut == "all", People, int(null))),
    conversations = max(iff(Cut == "all", Conversations, int(null))),
    share = max(SampleShare), run = max(Run)
| project pack = pack_array(
    pack("metric", "People", "value", todouble(people), "note", "about, rounded to five"),
    pack("metric", "Conversations", "value", todouble(conversations), "note", "about, rounded to five"),
    pack("metric", "Share sampled (%)", "value", round(100.0 * share, 0), "note", "of the conversations"),
    pack("metric", "Last run (days ago)", "value", todouble(datetime_diff("day", now(), run)),
        "note", format_datetime(run, "yyyy-MM-dd")))
| mv-expand pack
| project metric = tostring(pack.metric), value = todouble(pack.value), note = tostring(pack.note)
content.title: The latest run
Topics of the latest window (people)
Groups of the latest window
Topics per car model
Per client
Weekly trend per topic, 12 weeks (latest run of the latest window in each week)
Missing nights: days of the last 30 with no run. A night's window ends the day before yesterday, and is listed from 04:00 UTC
